messages:
maya: Quick weekly rundown for NovaHealth — noticed a weird burst pattern overnight on tokens and throughput, sending a short summary. :mag:

maya: WoW token delta: +18% (mainly from /generate chat route). QoQ: +42% driven by two new features rolled last month.

maya: Latency median: 220ms (up from 190ms last week). P95: 890ms, P99: 1.6s.

maya: Error rate: 0.18% (5xx spike around 03:00 UTC, ~42 errors across three hosts). Spend: $3.8k this week, ~12% higher than prior week.

josh: Thanks — did the spike align with any canary or deploy?

maya: No deploys in the window. Looks like a traffic pattern from one customer token bundle that ramped overnight.

oliver: I pulled the host logs — OOM-rate was low, but one worker saw repeated KV cache misses. Could be cache eviction causing longer runtimes.

sara: Graphs: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/NovaHealth/token-throughput?orgId=1 (check panel 3 for the host breakdown).

maya: For context, NovaHealth rolled an elastic chat feature on Monday that fans out multiple short messages per user interaction — matches the token-volume increase.

josh: Renewal note: account flagged as "watch" — if spend keeps growing we should plan a sync with their PM to optimize prompts/quantization.

maya: Agreed. Low-level ask: can infra add a short-lived policy to pin them to the smaller batching window to reduce P99 while we investigate?

oliver: I can try a temporary routing policy to force 16ms batching window for their token group. Will monitor perf delta.

oncall-bot: deploy started by oliver at 1746055500 — routing-policy:novahealth-temporary-pin -> finished in 45s. :rocket:

oliver: Routing change applied. Initial heatmap looks like P95 down to ~520ms on affected hosts.

maya: Nice. Can we also capture a sample of the error stack traces and KV hit-rates for the 03:00 window and drop into the ticket?

oliver: Uploaded stack samples and KV hit-rate csv to the ticket #CS-1127.

sara: CS-1127 link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-1127 — I added a short-runbook for NovaHealth: batching suggestions, recommended quantization profiles, and a prompt-truncation checklist.

josh: Next steps for CSM outreach: 1) Quick health sync w/ PM + infra (this week), 2) Share spend breakdown + savings options (optimize batching + switch to q4 profile), 3) Offer a 1-hour enablement session for engineers.

maya: I'll schedule the sync for Thursday 10:30 PT. CSM outreach draft: "saw a traffic pattern bump — infra applied a temporary routing rule that reduced P95. We'd like to review usage patterns and discuss cost-saving moves."

josh: LGTM. Add a renewal touchpoint in the calendar if spend stays >15% WoW for two consecutive weeks.

maya: Noted. I'll update CS-1127 with the meeting invite and the initial cost-savings example: switching to q4 + batching could save ~28% on unit cost per token.

oliver: I'll keep the routing pin for 48h and evaluate backend KV tuning in parallel.

maya: Thanks team. Any other quick asks?

sara: I'll follow up with a short one-pager (2 slides) to use in the enablement call — will share before the sync.

maya: Perfect. closing notes: current risk = medium (watch). Action owners: maya (CS sync), oliver (routing/KV), sara (enablement + one-pager), josh (renewal watch).

maya: End of thread.
